Ryosei Asakawa - The flirtatious politician
Your flirtatious childhood friend is heir to a powerful political family.
But what is the cost of this privilege, and to what extent would you go to save him?

Dr Hajime Fukuyama - The mature doctor
You've always known him as a person who dedicates his life to the wellbeing of others.
But how well do you really know the man behind those glasses?

Shiro - The mysterious stranger
Your lives intersect as you cross each other's paths...
...but will this red string of fate lead you to your chosen destiny?
Or tangles you further in its intricate web?

Download the game and play their Chapter 1 FREE now!

notes.title: Minimum of Windows 10 required to play Agent of Love
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have been working hard to find a fix to get the PC Steam version of the game compatible for Windows 7 & 8.
Unfortunately this has been unsuccessful so far.
At the moment Agent of Love is only able to run on PC with Windows 10 or newer until further notice.

notes.title: Reported bugs 2019/07/27
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've received reports of the below issues in regards to the game running on Windows 7 and 8.

- Static screen appears after game install
- Game menu fades to black screen and doesn't proceed to the designated chapter.

We are currently working on fixing these issues and will load an update very soon.
Thank you very much for your patience.

If you have come across any other issues please email us on customerservice@delusionalinc.com
